Our two most popular and essential products to get started are La Bonne Poêle (The Good Pan) and La Casserole Parfaite (The Perfect Saucepan). Here is a comparison to help you choose the one that will best suit your everyday life:

1. La Bonne Poêle (3-ply stainless steel)
This is our flagship product. It is designed to sear, brown, and grill at high temperatures without ever sticking if you use the water drop technique.

For whom? If you cook a lot of meat, sautéed vegetables, eggs, or fish.
Its strength: Its extreme versatility. You can use it for almost everything on a daily basis.
Budget: Starting at €79.00 (20 cm model).

2. La Casserole Parfaite (3-ply stainless steel)
It is deeper and narrower, which makes it ideal for cooking with lots of liquid.

For whom? If you often prepare sauces, soups, pasta, rice, or if you boil water.
Its strength: It has a very practical internal measuring scale and comes with its stainless steel lid.
Budget: Starting at €79.00 (14 cm model).

Which one to choose?
If you only had to choose one to start, we generally recommend La Bonne Poêle. It allows you to make a wider variety of everyday recipes.

However, if you make a lot of stews or sauces, the saucepan will be your best ally.

To help you decide, do you prefer cooking dishes that are seared (meat, stir-fries) or dishes that require water or broth? 🙂
